definitions: To present (someone) to another for the first time.
To bring (something) into use or existence for the first time.
To make (something) known or available for the first time.
To insert or put in (something) into a place.
To present a bill or motion in a legislative body.
examples: Let me introduce you to my colleague.
The company will introduce a new product next month.
He introduced a new method of teaching.
She introduced the key into the lock.
The MP introduced the bill to Parliament.
